definitions.explanation: A form of gymnastics combining dance, ballet, and gymnastics with the use of apparatus such as ribbons, hoops, balls, clubs, and ropes.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{新体操|しんたいそう}を{習|なら}っている。
examples.english: My daughter is learning rhythmic gymnastics.

examples.japanese: {新体操|しんたいそう}の{選手|せんしゅ}は{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}が{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: Rhythmic gymnastics athletes are required to have flexibility.

examples.japanese: オリンピックの{新体操|しんたいそう}{団体|だんたい}で{日本|にほん}チームが{銅|どう}メダルを{獲得|かくとく}した。
examples.english: The Japanese team won a bronze medal in the Olympic rhythmic gymnastics team event.

notes:
Literally 'new gymnastics,' composed of {新|しん} (new) + {体操|たいそう} (gymnastics/exercises). The name reflects that rhythmic gymnastics was introduced to Japan as a newer form distinct from traditional {器械体操|きかいたいそう} (artistic gymnastics on apparatus).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新体操|しんたいそう}の{選手|せんしゅ} — rhythmic gymnastics athlete
- {新体操|しんたいそう}{部|ぶ} — rhythmic gymnastics club (at school)
- {新体操|しんたいそう}{団体|だんたい} — rhythmic gymnastics team event
- {新体操|しんたいそう}{個人|こじん} — rhythmic gymnastics individual event

APPARATUS:
The five apparatus used in competition:
- リボン — ribbon
- フープ — hoop
- ボール — ball
- クラブ — clubs
- ロープ — rope

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {体操|たいそう} — gymnastics (general term); calisthenics
- {器械体操|きかいたいそう} — artistic gymnastics (on apparatus like bars and beam)
- {体操競技|たいそうきょうぎ} — competitive gymnastics
